items.title: Spirited England exit World Cup after Samoa loss
items.excerpt: England exit the Women's Rugby League World Cup as Samoa beat them 24-6 in their Group A decider in Wollongong.

items.title: Afcon to return to two-year cycle after Caf U-turn
items.excerpt: The African Cup of Nations (Afcon) will return to its traditional two-year cycle after a review into December's decision to host it every four years instead.

items.title: Many Turkish 'guest workers' hit by poverty in old age
items.excerpt: On October 30, 1961, West Germany and Turkey signed an agreement allowing the temporary recruitment of workers. Sixty-five years on, many so-called 'guest workers' cannot live from their pensions.

items.title: Sir Ian McKellen leads tributes to 'beloved actor' Sir Patrick Stewart after his death at 86
items.excerpt: The actor died in Los Angeles following a "a brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

items.title: Oil flows are up as Iran war turmoil eases. Why do prices keep rising?

items.title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
